ingredients.name: garlic, minced, or 1/8 teaspoon garlic powder
low-sodium red kidney beans, 15 1/2 ounces, drained and rinsed

steps.instruction: Heat 1/4 cup of olive oil in a 4-quart saucepan.
Add 1 clove of garlic, 1 1/3 cups of onion and 1 1/2 cups of celery.
steps.spoken: Add 1 clove of garlic, 1 1/3 cups of onion and 1 1/2 cups of celery. Saute for about 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 1 can of tomato paste and 1 tablespoon of parsley.
Add 1 cup of sliced carrots and 4 3/4 cups of shredded cabbage.
Add 1 can of tomatoes and 1 can of kidney beans.
Add 1 1/2 cups of frozen peas and 1 1/2 cups of green beans.
Add a dash of hot sauce and 11 cups of water.
Stir until everything is well mixed.
Reduce the heat, cover and simmer for 45 minutes.
steps.spoken: Reduce the heat, cover, and simmer for about 45 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Add 2 cups of finely broken spaghetti. Simmer for 2 to three minutes only.
